title: Kon Tum in a day
summary: Phở khô at the market, the wooden church and prison, then Kon Klor bridge and Kon K’Tu village. Coffee on the river after.

stops.name: Kon Tum market
stops.note: Two-bowl dry phở before the stalls thin out.

stops.name: Wooden church
stops.note: Nguyen Hue timber and stained glass.

stops.name: Kon Tum Prison
stops.note: Confirm the ticket at the gate.

stops.name: Kon Klor bridge and communal house
stops.note: Walk the bridge, then the nhà rông beside the river.

stops.name: Kon K’Tu village
stops.note: Stilt houses across the bridge. Ask before entering homes.

stops.name: Đăk Bla riverfront
stops.note: Coffee facing the river at dusk.

seoDescription: A one-day Kon Tum plan: market phở khô, the wooden church, Kon Klor bridge, Kon K’Tu village, and river coffee.
